modbus.description:
https://boneio.eu/docs/black/configuration/modbus 
 Modbus buses of boneIO Black: the built-in RS485 (uart4; uart1 on old boneIO) and USB RS485 adapters. A device without 'bus' is on the first.

id.description: Bus ID, which a device names in its 'bus'.
id.title: Id

port.description: The built-in RS485 by its UART (uart4), or a USB adapter by its /dev/serial/by-id path.
port.title: Port

timeout.description: Response timeout. Increase for slow devices or long cables.
timeout.title: Timeout

inter_device_delay.description: Delay between Modbus transactions. Helps with star topology wiring where signal reflections need time to settle. Recommended 5-50ms for star, 0 for daisy-chain.
inter_device_delay.title: Inter device delay

modbus.title: Modbus
